name: Tetrahedral Volume Integration
aliases: Volume enclosed with the iso-surface (tetrahedral decomposition)
definition: A method to compute the volume enclosed by an iso-surface generated from tetrahedral decomposition by summing the volumes of tetrahedra parts that lie inside the iso-surface.
summary: Tetrahedral Volume Integration computes the scalar volume enclosed by an isosurface by summing tetrahedra parts, providing a volumetric metric unlike surface extraction methods.
